summary: E2E backend testing of AMED-IA. 17/17 pytest cases pass. Verified 33 clinical cases across 14 specialties (17 individual + 16 team). Frontend login page renders correctly with Google OAuth (post-OAuth flows cannot be tested via Playwright due to real Google auth).

minor.issue: Returns 400 when team simulation chat is invoked without target_participant. Default value 'paciente' (line 484) is never present in team_members, so request always fails. Backend should either (a) default to the first team member, (b) treat 'paciente' as patient profile in team mode, or (c) return a 422 with clear field guidance. Frontend must ALWAYS pass target_participant for equipo_interdisciplinario cases.

integration_issues.issue: If SimulationView does not pass target_participant for team cases, chat will 400. Verify frontend always sends it.

issues: Page title is generic 'Emergent | Fullstack App' instead of 'AMED-IA'. Update public/index.html <title>.

action_items: Fix /api/simulations/{sim_id}/chat to handle team simulations gracefully when target_participant defaults to 'paciente' (currently 400s).
Verify frontend SimulationView always sends target_participant for team cases.

Cannot validate full UI flows (cases, simulation, evaluation, avatar) end-to-end via automated testing because login is gated by real Google OAuth. Main agent should self-test these flows by logging in manually.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 919 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, cases, simulations, dashboard) for maintainability (>700 line guideline).
Chat endpoint (line 460) uses target_participant default 'paciente' which is invalid for team simulations — fragile contract between frontend and backend.
Hardcoded model id 'claude-sonnet-4-6' in multiple LLM call sites — should be a constant/env var.
Good: All endpoints exclude MongoDB _id (projection {_id: 0}). Auth properly returns 401 on missing/invalid tokens. RBAC works (student->403 on POST /cases).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_amed_api.py (filter to individual case for streaming test)
test_credentials: Real Google OAuth via Emergent platform — no scriptable credentials. /app/memory/test_credentials.md documents OAuth-based auth only.
seed_data_creation: DB already seeded with 33 clinical cases. Tests create transient TEST_ users/sessions/cases and clean up via teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully passing (17 tests in /app/backend/tests/test_amed_api.py). Tests inject session tokens directly into MongoDB to bypass Google OAuth. Frontend protected routes (Dashboard, CaseLibrary, SimulationView, Profile) cannot be exercised by Playwright without a real Google account — main agent must manually verify. Known issue: chat endpoint 400s on team sims when target_participant omitted.
rca_of_the_issue: Original streaming test picked cases[0] (case_enf_ped003) which is a team simulation. Without target_participant, the endpoint reaches the team branch with default 'paciente' which is not in team_members list -> 400. Test fixed to filter individual cases. Underlying backend ambiguity remains for main agent to address.
